description: This file contains the implementation of the ProfileReader class, which reads user profile information from the database, checks for follower relationships, and returns a profile envelope. It interacts with Entity Framework Core for data access and AutoMapper for object mapping.

classes.name: ProfileReader
classes.description: Implements IProfileReader to fetch and construct user profile data, including follow status, based on the username. Utilizes dependency injection for database context, user accessor, and mapper.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a user profile by username, checks if the current user follows that profile, and returns the profile encapsulated in a ProfileEnvelope.
